body.prompt: Photoreal industrial-design studio render of one palm-sized upright camera, 39 W x 57 H x 33 D mm, concept ENTROPY: light reaching a black hole. image[1] = exact upright block and layout, keep it: SMALL 16 mm lens ring upper right, flash window upper left, shutter top front-left, slide switch top rear right, USB-C in the bottom. Idea ERGOSPHERE, a spinning black hole drags space with it: the graphite front plate is twisted a few degrees round the lens against the matte black body, its corners stepping out over the block as if dragged, the steps forming finger ledges. Round the lens sits a flattened oval collar, the ergosphere, with knurled rim and red index triangle: turning it drags six curved iris vanes inward to close the lens, a privacy cover; show it half closed. Short tangential turbine vanes skirt the collar. image[2] = knurled rotating ring with red index and tick scale. image[3] = stepped sculpted plate over a dark body. image[4] = flattened bright halo round a black sphere, for the oval collar. Collared shutter and two light-pipe dots on top, vent slots beside the USB-C, plug cover, corner eyelet, shadow-gap seam. Rich functional surface detail, printable PLA. One camera centred on pure white, 3/4 front view slightly from above, soft light, sharp. --no text, logos, letters, numbers, screen, hands, strap, extra lenses, big lens barrel, screws
